# Overview

This report is an optional manual view of the current JC outputs: AOI and maps,
raster/vector attribute extraction, and provenance/attribution records. Render
it after running the deterministic JC pipeline described in `docs/workflow.md`;
it reads those files directly and is not a `{targets}` target. The WMS and
ArcGIS images are offline placeholders in the `jc_ci` profile, not imagery
fetched from live services.

# Maps

## Overview map

```{r}
#| label: overview-map
knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
  '<img src="%s" class="img-fluid figure-img" alt="JC overview map">',
  knitr::image_uri(here::here("outputs/jc/maps/overview_map.png"))
))
```

#| label: panel-figure

# Site attributes (preview)

```{r}
#| label: attributes-preview
attrs_long <- arrow::read_parquet("outputs/jc/tables/site_attributes_long.parquet")
attrs_wide <- readr::read_csv(
  "outputs/jc/tables/site_attributes_wide.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  num_threads = 1
)

head(attrs_long, 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: attributes-wide-preview
head(attrs_wide, 5)
```
